CCSS-M.name: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics

CCSS-ELA.name: Common Core State Standards for English Language Arts & Literacy

caveats: Standards codes are linked only where the practice addresses the standard; "partial" means part of what the standard asks (often explaining, modelling or wider contexts) is not assessed.
No state-level alignment has been verified. Common Core and NGSS are adopted and modified differently by each state.
Social studies, personal finance and computer science skills have no mapped codes.
Content is authored by the Red Teddy team and checked by automated tests; no outside educator review has taken place yet.
